Well it's all right... now in 4K HD! Watch the newly restored, official music video for The Traveling Wilburys' "End of the Line".
The song appears on The Traveling Wilburys, Vol. 1 (1988), the classic debut album by the English-American supergroup comprised of George Harrison, Jeff Lynne, Bob Dylan, Roy Orbison and Tom Petty.
Music video by The Traveling Wilburys performing End Of The Line. 2007 T. Wilbury Limited.
